mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,outbox_id,status,attempt_count,locked_by,correlation_id,lock_version FROM outbox_event WHERE contract_ref IN (#{contractRef},#{contractRef2}) AND contract_version=1 AND aggregate_type='INCIDENT' AND attempt_count<=#{max_attempts} AND ((status='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at<=#{now}) OR (status='PUBLISHING' AND locked_at<=#{cutoff})) ORDER BY CASE WHEN status='PENDING' THEN next_attempt_at ELSE locked_at END, tenant_id,outbox_id LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE message_recovery SET state='RESOLVED',resolved_at=#{now},next_attempt_at=NULL, lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now},updated_by_type='SERVICE' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND direction='OUTBOX' AND source_record_id=#{outboxId} AND state='REPLAYING'

UPDATE incident_ticket_link SET retry_count=#{attemptCount},last_attempt_at=#{now},lock_version=lock_version+1, updated_at=#{now},updated_by_type='SERVICE' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND incident_id=#{incidentId} AND status='REQUESTED'

UPDATE outbox_event SET status='RECOVERY_REQUIRED',next_attempt_at=#{now},locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL, last_error_code=#{code},broker_confirmed_at=NULL,lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now},updated_by_type='SERVICE' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND outbox_id=#{outboxId} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND attempt_count=8 AND locked_by=#{token} AND lock_version=#{lockVersion} AND locked_at>#{cutoff}

UPDATE incident_ticket_link SET status='RECOVERY_REQUIRED',recovery_required_at=#{now}, recovery_reason_code=#{code},retry_count=8,last_attempt_at=#{now},lock_version=lock_version+1, updated_at=#{now},updated_by_type='SERVICE' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND incident_id=#{incidentId} AND status='REQUESTED'

UPDATE message_recovery SET state='OPEN',attempt_count=8,next_attempt_at=NULL, last_error_code=#{code},last_error_summary='Alert M7 publication exhausted again.', resolved_at=NULL,lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now},updated_by_type='SERVICE',updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND direction='OUTBOX' AND source_record_id=#{outboxId} AND business_intent_key=#{intent} AND state='REPLAYING'
mapper.select: SELECT business_intent_key,state FROM message_recovery WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND direction='OUTBOX' AND source_record_id=#{outboxId}
